"df38aa87-1012-5fca-b7e8-8bc10cbe5b07" :question/id #uuid "df38aa87-1012-5fca-b7e8-8bc10cbe5b07"] [:db/add "df38aa87-1012-5fca-b7e8-8bc10cbe5b07" :question/problem "Consider the system of linear equations

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}2x-4y+4z&=-4 \\ -2x+7y-z&=1 \\ 2x-5y+z&=-1\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system."] [:db/add "df38aa87-1012-5fca-b7e8-8bc10cbe5b07" :question/worked-solution "The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}2 & -4 & 4 & -4 \\ -2 & 7 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & -5 & 1 & -1\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=\frac{1}{2}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 2 & -2 \\ -2 & 7 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & -5 & 1 & -1\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 3 & 3 & -3 \\ 2 & -5 & 1 & -1\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 3 & 3 & -3 \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 3\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=\frac{1}{3}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 3\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -1\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-2y+2z&=-2 \\ y+z&=-1 \\ z&=-1\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=-1 \\ y&=-1-(1)(-1)=0 \\ x&=-2-(-2)(0)-(2)(-1)=0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle 0,0,-1\rangle$."] [:db/add "df38aa87-1012-5fca-b7e8-8bc10cbe5b07" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "df38aa87-1012-5fca-b7e8-8bc10cbe5b07" $$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-3 & -6 & -6 & 12 \\ -2 & -2 & 0 & 10 \\ -1 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{array}\right].

$$

$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 & 2 \\ -1 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{array}\right].

$$

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 2 & -2\end{array}\right].

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+2y+2z&=-4 \\ y+2z&=1 \\ z&=2\end{aligned}\right..

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=2 \\ y&=1-(2)(2)=-3 \\ x&=-4-(2)(-3)-(2)(2)=-2.\end{aligned}

$$

$$

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 & -6 \\ -1 & 3 & -2 & 2\end{array}\right].

$$

$$

Using $R_2:=-\frac{1}{2}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & -2 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 0\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-y&=4 \\ y&=3 \\ z&=0\end{aligned}\right..

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=0 \\ y&=3-(0)(0)=3 \\ x&=4-(-1)(3)-(0)(0)=7.\end{aligned}

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & 9\end{array}\right].

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{array}\right].

"b3a8e3f4-a642-5a95-aa9d-78680655fca3" :question/id #uuid "b3a8e3f4-a642-5a95-aa9d-78680655fca3"] [:db/add "b3a8e3f4-a642-5a95-aa9d-78680655fca3" :question/problem "Consider the augmented matrix

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-3 & -6 & -6 & 12 \\ -2 & -2 & 0 & 10 \\ -1 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-3 & -6 & -6 & 12 \\ -2 & -2 & 0 & 10 \\ -1 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=-\frac{1}{3}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -4 \\ -2 & -2 & 0 & 10 \\ -1 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 & 2 \\ -1 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & 2 & 2 & -2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=\frac{1}{2}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 2 & -2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -4\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+2y+2z&=-4 \\ y+2z&=1 \\ z&=2\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=2 \\ y&=1-(2)(2)=-3 \\ x&=-4-(2)(-3)-(2)(2)=-2.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle -2,-3,2\rangle$."] [:db/add "b3a8e3f4-a642-5a95-aa9d-78680655fca3" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "b3a8e3f4-a642-5a95-aa9d-78680655fca3" $$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-3 & -3 & -6 & 9 \\ 1 & 3 & 6 & -5 \\ -2 & -4 & -11 & 14\end{array}\right].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system."] ["6873a277-f0d2-5415-8c86-31c0c7eb85d9" :question/worked-solution "The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-3 & -3 & -6 & 9 \\ 1 & 3 & 6 & -5 \\ -2 & -4 & -11 & 14\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=-\frac{1}{3}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 1 & 3 & 6 & -5 \\ -2 & -4 & -11 & 14\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2-R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 & -2 \\ -2 & -4 & -11 & 14\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 & -2 \\ 0 & -2 & -7 & 8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=\frac{1}{2}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & -2 & -7 & 8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+2R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{3}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -2\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y+2z&=-3 \\ y+2z&=-1 \\ z&=-2\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=-2 \\ y&=-1-(2)(-2)=3 \\ x&=-3-(1)(3)-(2)(-2)=-2.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle -2,3,-2\rangle$."] ["6873a277-f0d2-5415-8c86-31c0c7eb85d9" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] ["6873a277-f0d2-5415-8c86-31c0c7eb85d9"
